user.title: Choose how Admin Inbox reads your mail
user.description: Admin Inbox turns bills, renewals, appointments and expiry notices arriving by email into structured household obligations, gated behind your review. Choose **IMAP** for a mailbox the built-in IMAP integration can log into directly. Choose **Webhook** for a mailbox that doesn't allow that anymore -- notably Microsoft 365 / Exchange Online, which retired password-based IMAP login -- where an external automation (e.g. a Power Automate flow) pushes new mail to Admin Inbox instead. One Admin Inbox instance watches exactly one mail source.

imap.title: Choose the mailbox to watch
imap.description: Pick the IMAP account it should watch.

webhook_confirm.title: Point your automation at this webhook
webhook_confirm.description:
Set up a Power Automate flow (or any automation with mailbox access) triggered on new mail. Have it POST a JSON body to this URL with fields `message_id` (required, a stable per-message id used for deduplication), `sender`, `subject`, `date`, and `text` (the plain-text body):

`{webhook_url}`

See the README for a Power Automate walkthrough. Click Submit once your automation is set up (you can finish setting it up afterwards -- this URL doesn't change).

ai_task.title: Choose the AI Task entity
ai_task.description: Pick the AI Task entity that will extract structured data from emails. It is called with no tools and no LLM API access.

filters.title: Optional filtering
filters.description: Optionally restrict which emails are ever sent to the model. One entry per line. Leave blank to process everything arriving in the watched mailbox.

data.sender_allowlist: Sender allowlist (email address or @domain, one per line)
data.keywords: Keywords (subject/body substring or regex, one per line)

abort.no_imap_entries_available: No available IMAP config entries found. Set up the IMAP integration first, or every IMAP entry already has an Admin Inbox instance.
abort.no_ai_task_entities_available: No AI Task entities found. Set up an AI Task-capable integration first.
abort.already_configured: This mail source is already configured.

store_unavailable.title: Admin Inbox storage is unavailable
store_unavailable.description: Admin Inbox could not read or write its storage file (disk full or corrupted). Processing has stopped until Home Assistant is restarted or the entry reloaded after the underlying problem is fixed.

store_schema_unsupported.title: Admin Inbox storage schema is newer than this version supports
store_schema_unsupported.description: The stored data was written by a newer version of Admin Inbox than is currently installed (for example, after a downgrade). Update the integration, or restore a compatible storage file, before Admin Inbox can run again.

ai_task_entity_missing.title: Admin Inbox's configured AI Task entity ({entity_id}) is unavailable
ai_task_entity_missing.description: Admin Inbox cannot extract data from emails until this is fixed. Check that the AI Task integration is set up and the entity still exists, then reconfigure Admin Inbox if it was renamed or removed.

imap_fetch_degraded.title: Admin Inbox is seeing repeated IMAP fetch failures
imap_fetch_degraded.description: Several email fetches have failed in the last 24 hours for entry {entry_id}. This usually indicates an IMAP-side problem (authentication, folder permissions, or connectivity) outside Admin Inbox's control. Check the IMAP integration's status.

imap_entry_removed.title: Admin Inbox's IMAP account was removed
imap_entry_removed.description: The IMAP config entry ({imap_entry_id}) this Admin Inbox instance depends on no longer exists. Remove this Admin Inbox instance, or restore the IMAP account.
